profile_text.body:
Atlassian is a publicly traded Australian software company, founded in 2002 and headquartered in Sydney, that makes collaboration and project management tools for software, IT, and business teams. Its flagship products include Jira, Confluence, Trello, Loom, and Rovo, and the company describes itself as providing a teamwork platform for the AI era in which teams and AI agents plan, execute, and deliver work together. Atlassian also describes its platform as designed to support evolving standards and regulatory requirements.

On the AI side, Atlassian offers Confluence AI, a team wiki product incorporating smart links, automation, and Atlassian Cloud governance, and Trello AI, which adds workflow automation and AI capabilities to its project management tool. Both products are governed under Atlassian Cloud.

Atlassian trades on Nasdaq under the ticker TEAM and files with the SEC under CIK 0001650372. Its most recently reported annual revenue, drawn from its 10-K for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2025, was $5,215,304,000. No litigation or MCP server entries are recorded in the held facts.
